adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the result of `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` in shared mode (a raw `Response`) (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). Multiple callers still treat the return value as an axios/SDK object: Google does `const token = res?.data` (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), Zoho Bigin and Zoho CRM do `tokenInfo.data...` / `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data...` after calling `refreshOAuthTokens` with axios refresh functions (packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts, packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts), and Hubspot assigns the result to `HubspotToken` (packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts). In shared mode these will produce undefined `.data` access / type mismatches and likely runtime crashes.
